component.name: Turbine Hub
component.summary: The first stop after installing SteamOS

description.p: Setup, checks and settings for SteamOS on handhelds, desktop PCs and TV PCs.

ul.li: Sets up a fresh SteamOS install for the machine it runs on
Checks the machine and the game library, with problems first and a fix for each
Shows every change before it is made, and every change can be undone
